metadata.creator: Royal Thai Legation
metadata.description: A representative of the Royal Thai Legation's Students' Department writes to President L. H. Upham of Miami University after returning to the Legation. The writer thanks Upham for courtesies received during a visit to the University, praises the work being done there, and expresses hope of being the agent through whom Upham secures a future Commencement speaker.
metadata.title: Letter to President L. H. Upham from Royal Thai Legation, 2 June 1942
metadata.transcript:
[page 1]
June 2, 1942

President L. H. Upham Miami University Oxford, Ohio

Dear President Upham:

Just a line, upon my return to the Legation, to thank you for the many courtesies which were shown to me while I was at the University, and to tell you again how proud I am of the wonderful work which you are doing there. There is a charm and a dignity about the place which I had never so thoroughly felt before. If only I could now be looking backward to the pleasure of having been the agent through whom you secured yesterday's Commencement speaker, my cup would indeed be running over. I shall still hope in that direction!

Kindest regards to Mrs. [Mistress] Upham and yourself.

Sincerely yours,

[handwritten] [illegible]
